# Verdance Systems AI

> Verdance Systems AI builds The Revenue Team for owner-led South African
> businesses: every enquiry answered within 60 seconds, every follow-up done,
> and the team's hours back. Live in 10 working days. It starts with a free
> Operations Map.

Founded and run by Daniel Bouwer, South Africa.
Website: https://verdancesystemsai.com
Contact: daniel@verdancesystemsai.com · WhatsApp and phone: +27 73 996 1535

## The facts

- Company: Verdance Systems AI, founded by Daniel Bouwer, based in South Africa.
- What it builds: The Revenue Team. Every enquiry on WhatsApp, phone, website,
  email and social answered within 60 seconds, day or night. Every quote and
  enquiry followed up until the customer replies. A person takes over the
  moment it matters.
- How fast: live in 10 working days from the day the plan is signed off.
- The 60-Second Guarantee: if fewer than 99% of enquiries are answered within
  60 seconds in a month, that month is credited.
- The Break-Even Exit: if the system has not paid for itself by day 90, the
  client can leave at the day-90 review.
- How it starts: a free 30-minute Operations Map. It shows where time and
  money leak in enquiries, follow-up and admin, in rand and hours, and what to
  fix first. The client keeps it whether or not they go ahead.
- When we propose: only if the client's own numbers show at least twice the
  monthly cost back.
- Who it is for: owner-led South African businesses where people spend the day
  answering customers, chasing sales and doing admin, or where one customer is
  worth R20,000 or more.
- POPIA: consent records, opt-outs and an operator agreement are built in.
- Ownership: accounts, automations and data are set up in the client's name.
- Prices: not published. Every quote is fixed and in writing, after the
  Operations Map.

## Free tool

Missed call calculator: https://verdancesystemsai.com/missed-call-calculator
Works out what unanswered calls and messages cost a business per year from
three of its own numbers: contacts missed per week, average customer value and
close rate (missed per week x customer value x close rate x 52). No sign-up.
